phases.name: The Long Howl
phases.say: (It throws back its head, and the moon answers.)

say.open: (A hound with the moon in its eyes waits at the edge of the road.)
say.death: (It bays once, and the moon goes dark.)

bestiary.lore: The card of illusion and the long night: a hound that bays at the moon and leads travelers off the road.
bestiary.weakness: Fire. Keep Sanity high; a sleeping party is a feast.
bestiary.pattern: Every fourth turn a lullaby on everyone (Sanity, Sleep); false light confuses and blinds a row; moonbeams hit the Back. At half, the lullaby every third turn.
